purpose: Search and execute a bounded local set of keyboard-first commands.
accessibility: The command surface is reachable with the documented keyboard shortcut.
The input and results expose labelled listbox semantics and restore focus on close.
responsive: Reflows within constrained containers without changing the content contract.
Retains shared control geometry and touch-target minimums.
motion: Uses shared duration and easing variables for state transitions.

api.name: onOpenChange
api.description: Callback fired when open state changes.
